Reshaping how healthcare teams operate.

Healthcare accidentally built one of the largest administrative workforces in the world. Every year, providers hire more people to answer phones, verify insurance, process invoices, post EOBs, and manage paperwork. We believe the next generation of healthcare organizations will scale with software instead.
At Arini, we deploy AI-native technology and engineers within leading dental organizations to improve patient access and simplify operational workflows—so patient engagement and back-office tasks run seamlessly without relying on brittle, outdated tools.
Book a Demo

The future is operational leverage

We don’t believe AI is another feature to bolt onto existing software. We believe it fundamentally changes how healthcare organizations should be built. Every workflow that is repetitive, measurable, and operational should ultimately be handled by intelligent software, allowing providers and staff to focus entirely on patients.

The Founders

We met in high school and have spent more than a decade building together.
‍
Along the way, we watched software reshape industries that once seemed impossible to change. But one industry stood apart. Healthcare touches every person on the planet, yet it remains incredibly difficult to operate at scale.
‍
We started Arini because we believe the next generation of healthcare organizations will be built differently. Better operations create better patient experiences, and better patient experiences create better outcomes.
‍
That’s the future we’ve dedicated our careers to building.

The Team

Arini brings together AI researchers, engineers, designers, and healthcare operators who share a common belief: exceptional patient experiences are built by exceptional teams. We work closely with our customers, obsess over the details, and believe the best products are built alongside the people who use them every day.

Abdul Jamjoom

Cofounder, CEO
Abdul studied at Harvard, where he worked on NLP research for low-resource languages, before leading Search and Applied AI at Threads (acquired by Shopify). He now leads Arini’s mission to give every patient the quality of care they deserve by reinventing the operations behind healthcare.

Rami Rustom

Cofounder, CTO
Rami worked as a software engineer at a couple of startups, during and after, studying CS at MIT. Before Arini, he worked at Threads (acquired by Shopify).

Growth
